program_author.responsibility: Create and validate the Start Package candidate in AUTHORING_ONLY mode.

human_gate_owner.responsibility: Approve baselines and issue, constrain or revoke authorizations.

design_authority.responsibility: Resolve normative ambiguity and approve explicit not-applicable decisions.

build_program_driver.responsibility: Compute and perform only the next eligible authorized transition and maintain state and ledgers.

coding_agent.responsibility: Implement the active bounded Workpack inside its capsule and command authorization.

main_build_project.responsibility: Build and package the target Agent or Harness.

external_conformance_lab.responsibility: Run authoritative external checks and issue certificate or findings.

read_only_linkage_review.responsibility: Verify normative, evidence, execution and repair linkage.

trusted_runner.responsibility: Execute authorized Codex, LLM or command invocations under Lab challenge and emit independent attestation.

certification_installer.responsibility: Sole owner of environment creation, install, uninstall, upgrade and cleanup operations.
